introHtml: Custom coins with zipper add a functional twist to traditional promotional coins. The integrated zipper closure turns a simple coin into a secure mini-pouch, perfect for storing keys, cash, or small accessories. Ideal for trade shows or corporate gifts, these coins offer a unique unboxing experience. Decorate with your logo through screen printing or debossing for a tactile brand impression that stands out from standard coin giveaways.
